content.comment_body: Hello, is it possible to have two programs in [product_name] [version_no] and choose which one to run?

It is not possible to have two programs in a [product_name]. You can only have one on the SD card and one in the internal memory, but selection between them is not supported. When a program exists on the SD card, it takes priority.

No, the [product_name] controller allows only one active program. Depending on your requirements, you might be able to combine both functionalities into a single program and use software switches to activate specific options. These switches allow you to select features by generating messages or changing settings.
Understood, thank you both for your assistance.

analysis.insight_summary: Users learned that the device only allows a single user program to be active, with no option for switching between multiple stored programs. A potential workaround was mentioned, involving incorporating multiple functions into one program with selectable options, but this does not replace native multi-program support. This restriction limits flexibility for users who need to switch between different applications on the same device.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the ability to store multiple user programs on the device and easily switch the active program without needing to reload or reprogram externally.
